correctness.rationale: All boundary equilibria except zero excluded by recovery. Positive equilibria exactly solve x_i^2/(1-x_i)=b_i s. Strictly decreasing E from n/2>1 to0 gives the unique nondegenerate minimum of L and exact branch counts. Rank-one diagonal similarity identifies lower saddle and upper stable branch. An explicit coercive weighted-gradient potential decreases strictly off equilibria and proves convergence of every trajectory via LaSalle and finiteness of equilibria, including the fold and faces. Strict concavity of log phi(exp u), Jensen/Karamata and envelope theorem prove sharp geometric mean bound, log-majorization and exact sensitivity. Five stdlib diagnostics and a separate symbolic check passed; computations are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete n-dimensional heterogeneous sharp fold/global convergence classification for a natural all-or-none infection rule fills the quantitative gap between known bistability demonstrations and coarse sufficient conditions. The strict fixed-geometric-mean log-majorization theorem identifies when response heterogeneity suppresses endemicity, with exact sensitivities. The coercive potential rules out cycles for all parameters and gives a nontrivial tractable benchmark. Not just a homogeneous scalar example or a threshold reparametrization.
